heuristics.description: Test too small, just right, and too big values for any bounded field.
Test values exactly at, one below, and one above a documented limit.
Test zero and negative values for any field assumed to be a positive quantity.
Feed unicode, emoji, whitespace-only, and mixed-script strings into text fields.
Check that monetary values never show float rounding artifacts and use consistent decimal precision.
Submit empty string, null, and missing-field variants for every required field.
Repeat an identical request/transaction and check for idempotency or unintended duplication.
Fire near-simultaneous or out-of-order requests against the same resource/account.
Check that sensitive fields (secrets, PANs, tokens) are never echoed back in responses or logs.
Compare two responses that should logically agree (e.g. same query, different path) for contradictions.
